title: Schools
subtitle: Manage schools and their branches
createDescription: The principal receives an SMS to set their password.
editDescription: Update the school's name and status.
empty: No schools yet. Add your first school.
created: School created. The principal has been notified by SMS.

branches.title: Branches
branches.name: Branch name
branches.search: Search by name, code, or city…
branches.empty: No branches yet. Add the first branch.
branches.editDescription: Update the branch's details and status.
branches.createDescription: Set the location and optionally assign the director — they get an SMS to set their password.
branches.directorHint: Optional — the director is texted a link to set their password.
branches.toggleFailed: Could not update the branch status.
branches.activateDesc: {name} will be switched back on. Its employees regain access to attendance, grades and every branch activity.
branches.deactivateDesc: {name} will be switched off. Teachers, directors and all branch employees immediately lose access to branch activities (marks, attendance, management) until it is reactivated.
branches.programsHint: Which programs this branch runs. Regular (the day program) is always included.
branches.programsEditHint: Adding programs updates the branch settings; existing programs stay (enrollments may depend on them).

matrix.title: Grades & programs offered
matrix.hint: Tick the grades this branch teaches under each education program. Grade filters across the app only show what you tick here.
matrix.programLocked: A running program can't be removed — uncheck its grades to phase it out.
matrix.lockedEnrollments: {count} live enrollment(s) in this program — move or withdraw them first.
matrix.lockedSections: {count} active section(s) in this grade — archive them first.
matrix.atLeastOneGrade: Pick at least one grade for at least one program.
matrix.scopeNote: Directors and branch staff will only see these grades in their filters, sections, fees and reports.
matrix.lockNote: Locked boxes hold live enrollments or the grade's last sections — they can't be unticked until those are moved.

contacts.replaceDescription: The new contact is sent an SMS to set their password. The current one is removed.

policy.title: Academic policy
policy.hint: Applies to every branch of this school.
policy.calendarHelp: How every date in the app, messages and reports is written for this school. Records are stored the same either way, and official documents always show both calendars.
policy.clockHelp: How times are written — standard (8:00 AM) or Ethiopian, counted from the morning (2:00 in the morning).
policy.gateSoft: Soft — employees may activate before payment
policy.gateHelp: New enrollments stay pending until the registration fee is paid or covered by a scholarship. Soft lets registrars activate provisionally; hard never does.
policy.thresholdHelp: Minimum annual average for a promote suggestion on the promotion board. Ministry policy default is 50.
policy.defaultsHint: Every branch inherits these. A branch can override them in its own Branch settings.
policy.teacherAssessmentsHelp: Let teachers add their own assessments on marklists that have no continuous-assessment plan. When off, only the school office defines assessment structure.
policy.lessonPlanDeptReviewHelp: When on, employees holding an active department head position can approve or decline lesson plans in their branch — alongside the director and principal. Their own plans still go to the director.

branchSettings.title: Branch settings
branchSettings.subtitle: How this branch runs — its policy overrides and setup shortcuts.
branchSettings.pickBranch: Pick a branch to manage its settings.
branchSettings.policyHint: Inherited from {school} unless customized for this branch.

links.timetableDesc: Periods, breaks and the weekly grid

alerts.title: Guardian alerts
alerts.hint: SMS (and email) sent to parents when their child is marked absent — from the register or the RFID gate.
alerts.enabledHelp: Text the guardian the moment their child is marked absent for the day.
alerts.lateHelp: Also text when a student arrives late (off by default — absent-only).

deviceMode.title: Device attendance
deviceMode.hint: How RFID card scans become attendance. Manage terminals and cards under Devices & cards.
deviceMode.autoAbsentHelp: Students with no scan and no manual mark by the cutoff are marked absent automatically (triggers the guardian alert). Only for branches with gate devices.
deviceMode.cutoffHelp: The sweep runs after this time on school days.
deviceMode.graceHelp: Scans within this many minutes after the class start still count as present.

concessionPolicy.title: Discount policy
concessionPolicy.hint: Detected cases file a suggestion for finance to approve — never a silent discount. 0% turns a policy off.
concessionPolicy.siblingPercentHelp: Suggested for families with enough enrolled children.
concessionPolicy.siblingMinHelp: Enrolled children that trigger the sibling policy.
concessionPolicy.staffPercentHelp: Suggested when a guardian is an active employee of the school.

billingPolicy.title: Billing & payment reminders
billingPolicy.hint: How recurring fees bill mid-year joiners, and the automated SMS/email reminder ladder for open invoices.
billingPolicy.prorationFullHelp: A student joining mid-month is billed the whole month.
billingPolicy.prorationDailyHelp: The first month is billed only for the days after enrollment.
billingPolicy.remindersEnabledHelp: Families get an SMS/email before the due date, on it, and while a bill stays unpaid — each rung at most once.
billingPolicy.daysBeforeHelp: How many days before the due date the first reminder goes out (0 = skip).
billingPolicy.overdueEveryHelp: How often families are reminded once a bill is past due.
billingPolicy.overdueMaxHelp: The ladder stops after this many overdue reminders (0 = none).

financeControls.title: Finance controls
financeControls.hint: Who handles money, and how expenses get approved. Only school managers can change these.
financeControls.selfApprovalHelp: Off: the person who records an expense can never approve it (four-eyes rule). Turn on only if one person runs your finance.
financeControls.directorAccessHelp: Off: directors are academic heads — no finance books, payment recording or fee management. Fee reports stay visible.

logo.confirmRemove: Remove this school’s logo? It will disappear from official documents.
logo.fieldHint: Shown on official documents (transcripts, report cards). PNG with transparency works best.
logo.uploadFailed: The school was saved, but the logo upload failed — try again from the profile.

staffAccounts.title: Staff portal accounts
staffAccounts.help: Job titles selected here get a Temari login (with a password-setup SMS) when hired. Unselected titles keep an HR file only.
staffAccounts.lockedHint: Teacher, director, registrar and finance officer always get an account — their role needs one.

chatPolicy.approvalFirst: Only the first message needs approval
chatPolicy.approvalHelp: The digital communication book: teacher messages to families wait for the director. “First message” reviews only the opening of each conversation. Branches can override this.
chatPolicy.studentsHelp: Students join their classroom groups and can message their teachers. Off by default.
chatPolicy.templateSuggested: Suggested — teachers may also write freely
chatPolicy.templateRequired: Required — family messages must use a template
chatPolicy.templateHelp: Preset messages (Messages → template icon) keep the tone consistent and arrive in the family’s own language. “Required” locks teacher→family texts to the preset list; directors are exempt. Branches can override this.

reportCardPolicy.perPageHelp: Bulk printing stacks 2 cards per page (top/bottom halves) or fits 4 in a 2×2 grid with cut lines — each student always fills their slot exactly, nothing ever overlaps.
reportCardPolicy.subjectRanksHelp: Show each subject's section rank beside the mark on the semester card.
reportCardPolicy.gradingCriteria: Grading criteria on the yearly card
reportCardPolicy.gradingCriteriaHelp: Print the letter-band legend (A = 90–100 …) on the yearly report card.
reportCardPolicy.skillsHint: Rows the homeroom teacher rates E / VG / S / NI each term; they print on the yearly report card. Leave empty for no checklist.
reportCardPolicy.noSchoolSkills: The school has no checklist yet.
reportCardPolicy.suggestedHint: Tap to add a suggested row:
